CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_followup_proof(tid uuid, pid uuid, actor uuid, op_name text, proof jsonb, saved_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS confirmations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; expected_tier text; uses integer;
BEGIN
  expected_tier := CASE op_name WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'T1' WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'T1'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.observation.record' THEN 'T1'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.review' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record' THEN 'T1' END;
  IF expected_tier IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(proof->>'tier'=expected_tier AND
    proof->>'id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires its exact shared proof tier and identity'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=(proof->>'id')::uuid;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR ROW(c.product_id,c.subject_id,c.actor_id,c.operation)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(pid,pid,actor,op_name) OR c.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR c.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT revision FROM products WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=pid)
    OR c.expires_at<=saved_at OR c.created_at>saved_at
    OR NOT COALESCE(c.payload_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND c.token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(c.snapshot)='object',false)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM principals WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=actor AND kind='human' AND active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires a consumed current Product proof by the named human'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO uses FROM (
    SELECT id FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND operation IN
      ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_observation_facts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_named_verification_reviews WHERE tenant_id=tid AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_verification_evidence WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One consumed proof must bind exactly one new followup target'; END IF;
  -- The reciprocal deferred transition guard and immutable consumed rows pair
  -- this target with a real False->True transition in the same UOW. No xmin/top
  -- xid assumption is used, so a legitimate SAVEPOINT remains supported.
  -- Python canonical material/token digests and runtime freshness still require
  -- quality_followup_host's actual marker; JSONB text hashing is not equivalent.
  RETURN c;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_quality_followup_confirmation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE old_scoped boolean := false; new_scoped boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN old_scoped := OLD.operation IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link','quality.capa.observation.record','quality.capa.verification.review','quality.capa.verification.candidate.record'); END IF;
  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN new_scoped := NEW.operation IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link','quality.capa.observation.record','quality.capa.verification.review','quality.capa.verification.candidate.record'); END IF;
  IF NOT (old_scoped OR new_scoped) THEN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof must be created unconsumed'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  ELSIF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
    IF OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof must be retained'; END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  IF NOT (old_scoped AND new_scoped) OR OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false
    OR NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'consumed') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'consumed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof only permits the exact unconsumed to consumed transition'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_quality_followup_consumption_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; uses integer; matched integer;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link','quality.capa.observation.record','quality.capa.verification.review','quality.capa.verification.candidate.record') THEN
    RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false OR NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof requires an actual consumption transition'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.id;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR to_jsonb(c) IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof cannot disappear or change before commit'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_id=c.product_id AND writer_id=c.actor_id
    AND operation=c.operation) INTO uses,matched FROM (
    SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND operation IN ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,'quality.capa.followup.link'::text AS operation
      FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM capa_observation_facts
      WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM capa_named_verification_reviews
      WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shared_proof_id=c.id
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record'::text
      FROM capa_verification_evidence WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 OR matched<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof must commit exactly one matching target atom'; END IF;
  -- The upgrade rejects legacy consumed three-op proofs. Thereafter every
  -- consumption must have one retained target, and every target must have one
  -- consumed proof. Reusing an old proof creates a second target and is rejected.
  -- Trigger events participate in SAVEPOINT rollback without top-xid guessing.
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_change_receipt(tid uuid, pid uuid, sid uuid, rev integer, op_name text, subject_name text, actor uuid, audience text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt action_receipts%ROWTYPE; expected_event text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO receipt FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
    AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name
    AND subject_type=subject_name AND actor_id=actor AND requester_id=actor AND run_id IS NULL
    AND visibility=audience;
  expected_event := CASE op_name
    WHEN 'quality.issue.create' THEN 'issue.created'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.merge' THEN 'issues.merged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.triage' THEN 'issue.triaged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.containment.record' THEN 'issue.contained'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.draft' THEN 'capa.drafted'
    WHEN 'quality.policy.import' THEN 'quality.policy_imported'
    WHEN 'change.request.create' THEN 'change.requested'
    WHEN 'change.impact.compute' THEN 'change.impact_created'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'issue.root_cause_decided'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'capa.actions_completed'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'capa.followup_linked'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.rule.import' THEN 'CapaVerificationRulePublished'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.observation.record' THEN 'CapaObservationRecorded'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.review' THEN 'CapaVerificationReviewed'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.verification.candidate.record' THEN 'CapaVerificationCandidateRecorded' END;
  IF receipt.id IS NULL OR expected_event IS NULL
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
      AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND actor_id=actor AND operation=op_name)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND type=expected_event AND actor_id=actor AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev
      AND correlation_id=receipt.command_id AND schema_version=1) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quality/change write requires exactly one named receipt, audit and event';
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE FUNCTION public.assert_capa_fact_source_closure(tid uuid, pid uuid, sources jsonb,
  reads jsonb, basis jsonb, audience text, owner uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$
DECLARE x jsonb; b jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(sources)>0
    AND jsonb_typeof(reads)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(reads) BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND jsonb_typeof(basis)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(basis)=jsonb_array_length(reads),false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA fact requires complete bounded source arrays'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'artifact_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) x)
       <>jsonb_array_length(reads)
    OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis) x)
       <>jsonb_array_length(basis) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA source identities cannot be duplicate or truncated'; END IF;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) LOOP
    IF NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(x)='object'
      AND (x-ARRAY['artifact_id','expected_revision'])='{}'::jsonb
      AND x->>'artifact_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(x->'expected_revision')='number'
      AND (x->>'expected_revision')::integer>0,false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA source read requires exact Artifact revision'; END IF;
    SELECT value INTO b FROM jsonb_array_elements(basis)
      WHERE value->>'id'=x->>'artifact_id';
    IF NOT COALESCE(b->'revision'=x->'expected_revision' AND b->>'status'='active'
      AND b->>'hash' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND b->>'visibility' IN ('private','product')
      AND b->>'owner_id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM artifact_versions a WHERE a.tenant_id=tid AND a.product_id=pid
        AND a.id=(x->>'artifact_id')::uuid AND a.revision=(x->>'expected_revision')::integer
        AND a.content_hash=b->>'hash' AND a.status='active'
        AND a.visibility=b->>'visibility' AND a.owner_id=(b->>'owner_id')::uuid)
      OR (b->>'visibility'='private' AND (audience<>'private' OR b->>'owner_id'<>owner::text)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA exact source identity or audience differs'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR x IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(sources) LOOP
    IF x->>'kind'='artifact' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(reads) r
      WHERE r->>'artifact_id'=x->>'id' AND r->'expected_revision'=x->'revision') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every Artifact source must remain in the complete read set'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- Raw native/uploaded provenance remains unchanged. Bytes, security epoch,
  -- issuer and professional qualification still require real host gates.
END $$;

CREATE FUNCTION public.assert_capa_fact_origin(tid uuid, pid uuid, project uuid, issue uuid,
  capa uuid, origin_id uuid, origin_rev integer, purpose_value text, nature_value text,
  anchor jsonb, reads jsonb, audience text, actor uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $$
DECLARE original quality_issue_versions%ROWTYPE; p projects%ROWTYPE; raw jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO original FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
    AND project_id=project AND issue_id=issue AND id=origin_id AND revision=origin_rev;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM projects WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid AND id=project;
  raw := anchor->'origin';
  IF original.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL OR p.status<>'active'
    OR (p.visibility='private' AND p.owner_id<>actor)
    OR original.operation<>'quality.capa.actions.complete' OR original.status<>'awaiting_verification'
    OR NOT COALESCE(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->>'id'=capa::text
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.issue_snapshot->'root_cause')='object'
      AND jsonb_typeof(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions')='array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions')>0
      AND NOT (original.issue_snapshot->>'needs_recheck')::boolean
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'merged_into'='null'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'effectiveness'='null'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'effectiveness_history'='[]'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'recheck_reasons'='[]'::jsonb
      AND original.issue_snapshot->'closure'='null'::jsonb
      AND raw->'ref'->>'id'=origin_id::text AND (raw->'ref'->>'revision')::integer=origin_rev
      AND raw->'ref'->>'snapshot_sha256'=original.snapshot_sha256
      AND raw->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=tid::text AND raw->'scope'->>'product_id'=pid::text
      AND raw->'scope'->>'project_id'=project::text AND raw->>'issue_id'=issue::text
      AND raw->>'purpose'=purpose_value AND raw->>'nature'=nature_value
      AND raw->>'owner_id'=original.owner_id::text AND raw->>'visibility'=original.visibility
      AND raw->>'writer_id'=original.writer_id::text
      AND raw->>'operation'=original.operation
      AND (raw->>'created_at')::timestamptz=original.created_at
      AND raw->'issue'=original.issue_snapshot AND raw->'input_snapshot'=original.input_snapshot
      AND raw->'authority_snapshot'=original.authority_snapshot
      AND raw->'policy_snapshot'=original.policy_snapshot
      AND raw->'persisted_source_basis'=original.source_basis
      AND reads @> original.required_source_read_set
      AND jsonb_typeof(anchor->'origin_required_source_read_set')='array'
      AND reads @> (anchor->'origin_required_source_read_set'),false)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(original.issue_snapshot->'capa'->'actions') x
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(x->'completion') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')
    OR (original.visibility='private' AND (audience<>'private' OR original.owner_id<>actor)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CAPA publication requires exact immutable completed origin and preserves private scope'; END IF;
  -- No comparison deletes Current descendant history. Legal later lineage and
  -- all original failure bytes must be attested by the missing actual owners.
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_followup_proof(tid uuid, pid uuid, actor uuid, op_name text, proof jsonb, saved_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS confirmations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; expected_tier text; uses integer;
BEGIN
  expected_tier := CASE op_name WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'T1' WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'T1' END;
  IF expected_tier IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(proof->>'tier'=expected_tier AND
    proof->>'id' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires its exact shared proof tier and identity'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=(proof->>'id')::uuid;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR ROW(c.product_id,c.subject_id,c.actor_id,c.operation)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(pid,pid,actor,op_name) OR c.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR c.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT revision FROM products WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=pid)
    OR c.expires_at<=saved_at OR c.created_at>saved_at
    OR NOT COALESCE(c.payload_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND c.token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(c.snapshot)='object',false)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM principals WHERE tenant_id=tid AND id=actor AND kind='human' AND active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup requires a consumed current Product proof by the named human'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO uses FROM (
    SELECT id FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=tid AND operation IN
      ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT id FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=tid
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'One consumed proof must bind exactly one new followup target'; END IF;
  -- The reciprocal deferred transition guard and immutable consumed rows pair
  -- this target with a real False->True transition in the same UOW. No xmin/top
  -- xid assumption is used, so a legitimate SAVEPOINT remains supported.
  -- Python canonical material/token digests and runtime freshness still require
  -- quality_followup_host's actual marker; JSONB text hashing is not equivalent.
  RETURN c;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_quality_followup_confirmation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE old_scoped boolean := false; new_scoped boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN old_scoped := OLD.operation IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link'); END IF;
  IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN new_scoped := NEW.operation IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link'); END IF;
  IF NOT (old_scoped OR new_scoped) THEN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; ELSE RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof must be created unconsumed'; END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  ELSIF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
    IF OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof must be retained'; END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  IF NOT (old_scoped AND new_scoped) OR OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false
    OR NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true
    OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'consumed') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'consumed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof only permits the exact unconsumed to consumed transition'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.require_quality_followup_consumption_atom()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE c confirmations%ROWTYPE; uses integer; matched integer;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.operation NOT IN
    ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete','quality.capa.followup.link') THEN
    RETURN NULL; END IF;
  IF OLD.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM false OR NEW.consumed IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Followup proof requires an actual consumption transition'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM confirmations WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND id=NEW.id;
  IF c.id IS NULL OR to_jsonb(c) IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(NEW) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof cannot disappear or change before commit'; END IF;
  SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE product_id=c.product_id AND writer_id=c.actor_id
    AND operation=c.operation) INTO uses,matched FROM (
    SELECT product_id,writer_id,operation FROM quality_issue_versions WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND operation IN ('quality.issue.root_cause.decide','quality.capa.actions.complete')
      AND source_basis->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
    UNION ALL SELECT product_id,writer_id,'quality.capa.followup.link'::text AS operation
      FROM capa_remediation_links WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id
      AND input_snapshot->'shared_proof'->>'id'=c.id::text
  ) u;
  IF uses<>1 OR matched<>1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Consumed followup proof must commit exactly one matching target atom'; END IF;
  -- The upgrade rejects legacy consumed three-op proofs. Thereafter every
  -- consumption must have one retained target, and every target must have one
  -- consumed proof. Reusing an old proof creates a second target and is rejected.
  -- Trigger events participate in SAVEPOINT rollback without top-xid guessing.
  RETURN NULL;
END $function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_quality_change_receipt(tid uuid, pid uuid, sid uuid, rev integer, op_name text, subject_name text, actor uuid, audience text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE receipt action_receipts%ROWTYPE; expected_event text;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO receipt FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
    AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name
    AND subject_type=subject_name AND actor_id=actor AND requester_id=actor AND run_id IS NULL
    AND visibility=audience;
  expected_event := CASE op_name
    WHEN 'quality.issue.create' THEN 'issue.created'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.merge' THEN 'issues.merged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.triage' THEN 'issue.triaged'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.containment.record' THEN 'issue.contained'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.draft' THEN 'capa.drafted'
    WHEN 'quality.policy.import' THEN 'quality.policy_imported'
    WHEN 'change.request.create' THEN 'change.requested'
    WHEN 'change.impact.compute' THEN 'change.impact_created'
    WHEN 'quality.issue.root_cause.decide' THEN 'issue.root_cause_decided'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.actions.complete' THEN 'capa.actions_completed'
    WHEN 'quality.capa.followup.link' THEN 'capa.followup_linked' END;
  IF receipt.id IS NULL OR expected_event IS NULL
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM action_receipts WHERE tenant_id=tid AND product_id=pid
      AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev AND operation=op_name)<>1
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_entries WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND actor_id=actor AND operation=op_name)
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id)<>1
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=tid AND receipt_id=receipt.id
      AND type=expected_event AND actor_id=actor AND subject_id=sid AND subject_revision=rev
      AND correlation_id=receipt.command_id AND schema_version=1) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quality/change write requires exactly one named receipt, audit and event';
  END IF;
END $function$
